quests.title: Follow the Lost Lights
quests.description: The meadow's light has drifted away. Gather it and bring it home to the Heart Tree.

steps.text: Gather light for the Heart Tree
Bring the light to the Heart Tree

hints: Lights float all around Whispering Meadow. Press H and I'll point toward the nearest one.

quests.title: Lanterns of Firefly Grove
quests.description: The Heart Tree remembers a grove where lanterns once filled the night sky.

steps.text: Follow the path north-west to Firefly Grove
Hold a Lantern Night at the shrine

hints: Waystones let you travel back here any time, for free. The shrine is in the grove's clearing.

quests.title: Awaken Crystal Creek
quests.description: The lanterns' light points east, to crystals that have fallen asleep by the water.

steps.text: Guide the sun's beam to the heart crystal

hints: The crystal puzzle is just south-west of the creek's waystone. There is no wrong move; the lever resets it.

quests.title: Restore the Heart of Lumeria
quests.description: With the creek awake, the moonlit veil to the north has faded.

steps.text: Enter the Moonlit Sanctuary to the north
Restore the Heart of Lumeria at the moon altar

hints: The sanctuary is straight north of the Heart Tree.
